issue.before: Callable ToolInfo.parameters was omitted by the descriptor sanitizer and JSON serialization. Metadata-only tool entries were incorrectly labeled tool-schema.
issue.providerPacketCaution: The whole provider Context.tools fingerprint includes more than parameter schemas; its size must not be interpreted as the parameter schema size.

change.capture: Explicit public callable parameters.toJsonSchema({target: draft-2020-12, fallback: context.base}), then existing descriptor-safe privacy filter and quotas. Plain JSON Schema is retained with provenance.
change.readSafety: Own data descriptors for ToolInfo metadata/parameters; bounded 8-level prototype data-descriptor lookup for the public conversion method; first accessor refuses capture. Reflect.apply preserves receiver without reading a call getter. Callable values must have both data-method assert and toJsonSchema, matching public native isArkSchema; validators/assertions are never invoked.
change.failure: Conversion failure remains unknown and does not stop native execution; metadata-only snapshots expose native-tool-parameters missing coverage. Declared schemas remain distinct from provider normalization.
change.ordering: The actual getActiveTools order determines recorded definitions; schemas are refreshed on actual context events.
change.probe: Actual delivered per-tool parameter hashes and byte lengths are captured at fixture-provider Context. Observed declarations are converted with public native arkToWireSchema/toolWireSchema and normalizeTools. Matching native normalization profiles must reproduce exact actual delivered hash/bytes and ordered names for root, task child, restricted grandchild and eval. Matching profile equality does not claim configured-option readback.

independentSourceReview.result: No remaining concrete scoped defect after descriptor-method and Reflect.apply fixes. Supported public native converter exports and declared/provider boundary checked read-only.
